LookupItem.description:
One picker row.

``abbrev`` is ``None`` for the four lookup tables that have no abbreviation
column (``event_types``, ``mission_types``, ``astronaut_statuses``,
``agency_types``). The key is **always emitted**, never omitted: the
contract writes it ``abbrev?``, and one stable shape is what keeps the
generated Kotlin client from seeing two different row types in one payload.
